Db._Path_legacy_comment: Forge:Db:Path is legacy. When set it takes precedence and the control DB lives at that exact path. Prefer Forge:Db:Folder for new configs.
Db._SplitEnabled_comment: Phase B/F gate. When true, /api/admin/db/split-dry-run and (Phase F) the auto-split-on-first-boot migration are reachable. Default false until the operator validates the partition report.
Db._MaxConcurrentProductDbs_comment: Phase E — cap on concurrent product-DB opens per worker tick (used by ProductFanout). Bumps if you have CPU/memory headroom and >20 products; lower if SQLite file-handle limits bite.

Stories._E2eUseBddPattern_comment: Phase 94 — global default qa-e2e test STYLE. true (default) = BDD/Gherkin acceptance tests (a .feature file + step bindings: Reqnroll for .NET — pinned to the repo's detected runner MSTest/xUnit/NUnit — godog for Go, cucumber-rs for Rust, pytest-bdd for Python, Cucumber-JVM for Java). false = plain idiomatic test methods (one per scenario) in the repo's existing framework, no .feature file. Per-repo RepoRow.E2eUseBddPattern overrides this. Omit the key to keep the default (true).

Agents._CopilotCliPath_comment: 2026-05-22 — pin the Copilot CLI Forge spawns. Without this, ResolveCopilotCli picks the stale npm-bundled @github/copilot-sdk launcher (1.0.39), whose per-version pkg runtime gets raced/overwritten by concurrent copilot.exe processes → intermittent 'spawn rg.exe ENOENT' / 'Failed to load native module: conpty.node', so agent shell/grep tools die and agents can't self-verify builds. Point at the up-to-date standalone CLI instead.

Test._ExcludeFilter_comment: vstest --filter sub-expression AND-merged into every story-gate `dotnet test` (per-iter + post-pass) AFTER impacted-test resolution. Use to skip chronic pre-existing flakes that burn the gate's wall-clock budget. Global across all repos/products — clear once the underlying flakes are fixed.

Chat._comment: Telegram and Slack plugins are available. Engine defaults to legacy until configured or explicitly migrated. Stage 6 persists exclusive engine ownership in the control DB across restarts. Enabled=false stops both engines; an explicit migration opts in when Enabled is absent. HostId must remain stable.

ChatBridge._comment: Legacy Telegram bridge: outbound notifications, per-spawn forum topics, and guarded inbound handlers are shipped. Disabled by default; explicitly opt in via host-user chat-settings.json or Forge__ChatBridge__Enabled. AllowRemoteActions=false keeps notifications read-only. Store tokens in the environment or the DPAPI blob, never in source. See docs/chat/host-chat-configuration.md.
